provisionalSurvivor.name: Supported Enrollment Relation
provisionalSurvivor.compression: Coarse Resource relation has two semantic coordinates (actor/system scope, aspect identity) plus two proof obligations (at least one transition witness, evidence envelope proving bounded admissible enrollability). Transition family is retained in ResourceFor when precision is required; owner/authority/access/capacity/currentness/cost/dependencies/failure-domain/substitutability are not universal Resource identity fields.

implementationDebt.result: Current evaluate_resource can return consumable-now when required capability exists only in aggregator-authored ResourceCandidate.capabilities while OwnerVerification confirms terms/interface but does not attest the capability semantics.
implementationDebt.interpretation: Transition witness provenance is a real truth-boundary requirement. This is recorded as an existing evaluator debt; R3 does not modify production code.

implementationDebt.result: Current evaluate_resource also returns consumable-now when ResourceCandidate has mixed owner+aggregator resource-level provenance, while the owner evidence proves resource existence/terms/interface and only the aggregator claim semantically supports the required capability.
implementationDebt.interpretation: Resource-level owner provenance is insufficient to prove claim-level transition semantics. Evidence support must preserve which native claim supports which transition witness; merely having some owner provenance on the ResourceCandidate cannot upgrade unrelated capability labels.

centralResult: Resource is provisionally a supported relation projection across truth owners: coarse identity uses actor/system scope + aspect identity, while transition witness and evidence envelope are proof obligations. Current authority/access/capacity are Actionability joins; currentness is claim-local; failure-domain/substitutability are portfolio relations.
